meta.description: Triage Agent + Intent Router (the front door). Mirrors flows/triage-router.py. POST /sms receives RC webhook, verifies signature, classifies with Claude Haiku into {appointment, file_request, patient_lookup, general_message}, dispatches to per-intent handler stub, writes ONE row to audit_log.py per request. Per Q10: always 200s so RC doesn't retry-then-disable; per Q11: requires Anthropic BAA before pointing at PHI. Credentials needed (set in n8n env): ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, RC_WEBHOOK_VERIFICATION_TOKEN, AUDIT_LOG_PEPPER. Optional: TRIAGE_MODEL, AUDIT_LOG_PATH.
